lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb6Au2 (reduced formula Rb3Au) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with nine Rb neighbors (2.86–2.98 Å) and Rb centers with ten geometric neighbors (2 Au, 8 Rb). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Rb 10-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Au and Rb polyhedra.
